---
title: "Centre Images"
format: typst
filters:
  - gallimaufry
extensions:
  gallimaufry:
    center-images: true
---

## Default alignment (centre)

A standalone image is wrapped in `#align(center)[...]` by default.

![A placeholder image](https://placehold.co/400x200)

## Custom alignment

An image with `img-align="right"` is wrapped in `#align(right)[...]`.

![Right-aligned image](https://placehold.co/400x200){img-align="right"}
